correctness.rationale: The integer unimodular transformation (u,v)=(x−2y,y) conjugates F to (u+delta,4v+u+f), with exact nth iterate (u+n delta,4^n v+H_n(u+f)+W_n delta), H_n=(4^n−1)/3, W_n=(4^n−1−3n)/9 an integer. The rational-base return condition is precisely q|n; fixed-point character H_n u+(4^n−1)v+constant=0 has gcd(H_n,4^n−1)=H_n parallel connected kernel circles. Their common direction makes any smaller-period fixed component either entire or disjoint, so Möbius inversion yields exact primitive-period component counts. Fourier frequencies map (a,b) to (a+b,4b) under Koopman, forcing all L2 eigenfunctions to have b=0 and giving the claimed ergodicity/eigenvalue conclusions; irrational base ergodicity plus full-support Haar yields generic density, rational base gives q expanding-fiber circles. Independent exact-fraction iteration checks and Möbius arithmetic tested q=1,2,3,5 and several translation examples; not a substitute for all-parameter proof.

final_claim: The affine torus map F_(e,f)(x,y)=(3x+2y+e,x+2y+f) on T^2 has no periodic points and Haar-typical dense torus orbits when delta=e−2f is irrational; for delta=p/q rational its least period qk occurs on B_(q,k)=(1/3)sum_(d|k)mu(k/d)(4^(qd)-1) distinct essential embedded circles and Haar-typical orbit closures comprise q circles.
